component_source_policy: DNA atom/bond definitions are adapted from bundled HDF5 templates; each suite stores the component template SHA-256.
interpretation_limit: All suites come from one structure entry (119D); chains within the entry are not independent families. This source set is not an independent benchmark or general DNA conformer library.

suites.coordinate_frame: MDNA ReferenceBase single-base frame with [b_D,b_L,b_N] axes; not a base-pair frame
